name: Report Pilot
description: Scheduled store reports, delivered by email and kept in your dashboard

images.title: Your key numbers, in every inbox
images.description: Sales, customers, inventory and more, emailed daily, weekly, every 2 weeks or monthly, around 08:00 in your store's time zone.

images.title: Every report kept in your dashboard
images.description: Each period is saved under Reporting, with the same figures as the email, links to products and customers, and Show more for long lists.

images.title: Abandoned carts and subscriptions
images.description: See which carts came back as orders, what's left behind, your monthly recurring revenue and the renewals that failed.

images.title: Set it once, send to the right people
images.description: One list gets every report, and anyone can be added to a single report. Pick your time zone, or send any report right now.
